segments.title: Sea pigs hide a SECRET under their skin
segments.say: Sea pigs hide a secret under their skin: a bacterium nobody had named.

segments.title: It's NOT a pig
segments.say: First: a sea pig is not a pig. It's a sea cucumber.

segments.title: It lives 6,000 m DOWN
segments.say: It can live six thousand meters deep.

segments.title: ONE bacterium, over 70%
segments.sub: Of the bacteria **in its body wall**
segments.say: In its body wall, one single kind of bacterium made up more than seventy percent of the bacteria found.

segments.title: Its genome is TINY
segments.say: Its genome is tiny: about seven times smaller than E. coli's.

segments.title: Found by University of Tokyo
segments.say: University of Tokyo scientists just described it.
Follow for Weird Animal number 25 tomorrow.
